name: olmOCR-bench
intro: olmOCR-Bench 是用于评估 PDF 文档提取系统的单元测试基准。发布版包含 1,403 份高难 PDF 和 7,010 项二元测试，覆盖文本存在/缺失、自然阅读顺序、表格关系、数学公式以及基础输出健全性，并按七类文档来源宏平均。
build_method: 七类来源筛选, 人机协同单元测试编写, 人工复核, URL去污染
metric: Binary unit-test pass rate, Document-source macro average
eval_feature: 7类文档来源, 5类内容测试, 基线健全性测试, 二元评分, 来源宏平均
build_method_en: Seven-source curation, human-and-model unit-test authoring, manual review, URL decontamination
eval_feature_en: Seven document sources, five content-test categories, baseline sanity tests, binary scoring, source macro average
intro_en: olmOCR-Bench is a unit-test benchmark for PDF document extraction systems. The released benchmark contains 1,403 challenging PDFs and 7,010 binary tests spanning text presence and absence, natural reading order, table relationships, mathematical formulas, and baseline output sanity, with macro-averaging across seven document sources.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.18443v3 Section 3 and Appendix F.1 plus the released olmOCR-Bench dataset. Seven sources cover arXiv math, old-scan math, tables, old scans, headers and footers, multi-column pages, and long tiny text. Source-specific human, LLM-assisted, and scripted tests are manually verified; documents containing PII or lacking public-distribution permission are removed; URLs are deduplicated against olmOCR-mix-0225. The release contains 1,403 PDFs and 7,010 tests: 721 text-presence, 823 text-absence, 1,061 reading-order, 1,020 table, and 3,385 formula tests, plus baseline sanity checks. OCR output is normalized before binary scoring, source pass rates are macro-averaged, and results use bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. One paper prose location says 1,402 distinct PDFs, while the v3 release table and current release use 1,403; the diagram follows the release total.
